claims.cytotoxic_mechanism: Diethylcarbamazine at 2.5 uM is unlikely to kill cancer cells directly; it is a weak lipoxygenase/cyclooxygenase-pathway modulator with no described cytotoxic mechanism at low micromolar concentrations, so any antiproliferative effect would be minimal.
